source_evidence: Non-traded REITs typically do not provide an estimate of their value per share until 18 months after their offering closes.
question: Misconception: A non-traded REIT regularly provides investors with an estimate of its share value soon after they invest.
answer: A non-traded REIT’s share value can be difficult to determine. It typically does not provide an estimate of value per share until 18 months after its offering closes, which may be years after an investor has invested.
